newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's Riksbank set repo at unchanged 4.10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's Riksbank set repo at unchanged 4.10 pct.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, set a one week repurchase operation at an unchanged fixed rate of 4.10 percent on Tuesday, as expected by the market.
The operation will run from July 30 to August 6 with bids due by 0800 GMT on July 29 at the latest.
The repo rate is the bank's key tool for controlling market money liquidity. It has been unchanged since December 17 last year when it was lowered by 25 basis points.
The central bank's other key interest rates, the deposit and lending rates, stand at 3.75 percent and 5.25 percent respectively.
